abort.login_expired: The sign-in expired. Start setup again to get a new code.
abort.no_accounts: No active Meridian electricity accounts were found.
abort.too_many_attempts:

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That email doesn't match this Meridian Energy entry. To use a different email, remove the integration and add it again.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Meridian. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.cleanup_pending: Home Assistant is still saving data. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.import_cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Meridian. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.import_invalid_data: Meridian sent history Home Assistant couldn't use. Try again later.
error.import_rate_limited: Meridian asked Home Assistant to slow down. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.import_statistics_refused: Older Meridian Energy statistics for this property can't be continued, so nothing was imported. To start again, delete them in Settings → Tools → Statistics.
error.import_statistics_write: Home Assistant couldn't confirm the history was saved. It may be busy, for example with a backup. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.import_timeout: The import took too long. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: Meridian rejected the sign-in. Request a new code and try again.
error.invalid_data: Meridian sent account details Home Assistant couldn't use. Try again later.
error.last_upstream_timeout: Meridian didn't answer in time, and no import attempts are left.
error.last_upstream_unavailable: Meridian's service returned an error, and no import attempts are left.
error.otp_expired: That code has expired. Start setup again to get a new one.
error.otp_invalid: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
error.otp_not_found: That code was already used or wasn't found. Start setup again.
error.otp_too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Start setup again to get a new code.
error.rate_limited: Meridian asked Home Assistant to slow down. Try again later.
error.retry_too_soon: Wait {seconds} more seconds, then try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, the Home Assistant log has the details.
error.upstream_timeout: Meridian didn't answer in time. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
error.upstream_unavailable: Meridian's service returned an error. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

user.title: Connect Meridian Energy
user.description: Enter the email you use for MyMeridian. Meridian will email you a six-digit code. No password needed.

otp.title: Enter your code
otp.description: Enter the six-digit code Meridian sent to {email}.

discovery_retry.title: Couldn't load your accounts
discovery_retry.description: You're signed in, but Meridian didn't send your accounts. Select Submit to try again. You won't need a new code.

accounts.title: Choose accounts
accounts.description: Each account gets its own device and Energy statistics.

data_description.selected_accounts: Select them all to add new accounts automatically. You can change this later with Reconfigure.

import_failed.title: History import failed
import_failed.description:
Select Submit to try again. You won't need a new code.

Details: {detail}.

data_description.continue_without_history: Finish setup now and import your history in the background.

import_failed_last.title: History import failed
import_failed_last.description:
The import failed 5 times. To finish setup anyway, turn on Continue without history and select Submit; your history will import in the background. Otherwise, select Submit to cancel setup.

Details: {detail}.

data_description.continue_without_history: Finish setup now and import your history in the background.

reconfigure.title: Choose accounts
reconfigure.description: Removing an account removes its device but keeps its past Energy statistics.

data_description.selected_accounts: Select them all to add new accounts automatically.

reconfigure_discovery.title: Couldn't load your accounts
reconfigure_discovery.description: Meridian didn't send your accounts. Select Submit to try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Meridian Energy
reauth_confirm.description: Meridian has ended the sign-in for {email}. Select Submit to get a new code.

progress.initial_import: Importing your last 90 days of usage and cost. This can take a few minutes. Keep this window open.

create_entry.partial: Meridian Energy is connected. The rest of your history will import in the background, and the Current bill sensors will fill in as it does.

cannot_connect.message: Couldn't reach Meridian. Home Assistant will try again automatically.

upstream_unavailable.message: Meridian's service returned an error ({detail}). Home Assistant will try again automatically.

upstream_timeout.message: Meridian's service did not answer in time ({detail}). Home Assistant will try again automatically.

invalid_auth.message: Meridian no longer accepts the stored session. Reauthenticate the integration.

invalid_data.message: Meridian returned invalid electricity data. Home Assistant will try again automatically.

rate_limited.message: Meridian asked Home Assistant to wait before trying again.

recorder_busy.message: Home Assistant is still saving earlier statistics. Meridian Energy will try again automatically.

statistics_write.message: Home Assistant couldn't confirm Meridian's statistics were saved. It will import them again automatically.

statistics_refused.message: Older Meridian Energy statistics can't be continued, so nothing was imported. To start again, delete them in Settings → Tools → Statistics.

migration_unsupported_version.message: This Meridian Energy configuration entry (version {version}) is not supported by this release. Remove the integration and add it again.

migration_incomplete_entry.message: This Meridian Energy configuration entry was not completed on v0.2.4, so it cannot be upgraded safely. Restore it, or complete it on v0.2.4, before upgrading; or remove the integration and add it again.
